segments.summary: Reviewed source-control staging, discard, diff search, commit, and conflict controls; identified missing destructive-safety semantics while confirming explicit concept-lineage demotion.
Reviewed conflict resolution, remote projection badges, reconnect, and source-control history controls; the reconnect GUI promise lacks an executable retry/outcome model.

Reviewed compare-target, graph, branch, and stash controls; branch/stash interaction remains intentionally non-production but unresolved for authority, accessibility, conflict, and recovery semantics.

Reviewed stash, run/workflow, secrets, container, image, and publishing controls; sensitive and destructive DevOps affordances remain unowned concept lineage, with stale BUILD / BAKE naming explicitly rejected.
Reviewed publishing, artifact, route-kind, editor-tab, and browser-preview controls; route-type separation is explicit, but production tab semantics and accessibility remain absent.
Reviewed automation/browser tabs, navigation, capture-to-chat, permissions, sharing, and agent takeover; privacy, consent, data lifecycle, propagation, and execution authority are unresolved.
Reviewed agent takeover continuation/stop, sample-site navigation, login inputs/actions, policy links, and context-pane controls; authentication and privacy behavior is visual lineage only.

Reviewed context detail, Plan Compile routing, runtime lifecycle buttons, and Open Build; the two route controls are bounded and testable, while adjacent lifecycle authority remains concept-only and unsafe to infer.

cross_document_questions: Which canonical owner documents, if any, promote branch/stash, DevOps publishing, browser-agent sharing, authentication, and runtime lifecycle controls into production commands?
Where are destructive confirmations, optimistic concurrency preconditions, rollback semantics, and no-data-loss acceptance oracles defined for source-control and runtime-stop actions?
Where are browser-to-chat capture consent, redaction, retention, agent-sharing authority, and support/audit receipts defined?
